mechanism: Pyrazinamide can cause hepatotoxicity and hyperuricemia, and atazanavir is hepatically metabolized; concurrent use increases hepatic injury risk and may elevate atazanavir levels.
action: Monitor liver function tests closely; consider alternative TB regimen (isoniazid/rifampin-based without pyrazinamide) if possible, or dose adjust atazanavir based on hepatic function.
